caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile with a predominantly beige or off-white color. The upper portion of the textile features faint, light gray floral patterns scattered across the surface. Moving down, there are three horizontal red bands arranged across the width of the textile. The central, broadest red band displays a decorative white floral pattern with various leaves, stems, and stylized flowers. Above and below this large red band are two narrower red bands that each contain repeating geometric motifs in white, comprising diamond and cross shapes. Below the horizontal bands, the textile ends with a section of beige fringe composed of evenly spaced, long strands that create a tasseled effect. The overall composition is vertically aligned with bands and decorations concentrated toward the lower half.
title: Linen Towel - Flower Design
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
